profile.summary: Cold Air Refrigeration, Inc., which does business as Cold Temp Solutions, is a company in Martinez, California. It designs, installs and maintains industrial and commercial refrigeration systems for food storage, pharmaceutical, post-harvest and winery facilities, and offers 24/7 emergency response. It has operated since 2017.
